customer_terra: Hi team — our app is hitting a streaming issue with the Python SDK. Generator yields a few tokens then stalls (no more chunks) even though the server keeps sending SSE events. Happens intermittently and often after a transient 401/502 and retry.

customer_terra: Minimal repro:
```python
from redwood import Client
import os
cli = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = cli.chat.stream(model='re12-large', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'tell me a story'}])
for piece in resp:
    print(piece.text, end='')
# prints '...process' then nothing, generator never yields again
```

customer_terra: Logs show SSE frames arriving but parser seems to stop:
```
[2026-03-14 09:12:11] INFO sse_client: received: event: delta
data: {"text": "process"}
[2026-03-14 09:12:12] ERROR auth: got 401 refreshing token
[2026-03-14 09:12:12] INFO sse_client: reconnecting after transient error
[2026-03-14 09:12:12] INFO sse_client: received: event: delta
data: {"text": "ing"}
[2026-03-14 09:12:12] WARNING sse_parser: buffer not flushed, waiting for delimiter
# then no further output, client generator blocks
```

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you confirm which python-sdk version you're using and whether you have automatic retries enabled (we have a known interaction there)? Also any proxy / load balancer in front?

customer_terra: Using redwood-sdk 0.12.3, python 3.10. No custom proxy, but our infra does have retries at the requests layer (we use urllib3 Retry with backoff).

jake_support: Thanks — two things to try while we investigate: (1) pin to 0.12.1 (we suspect a regression in the SSE parser in 0.12.3), (2) disable upper-layer automatic reconnects so the SDK can manage SSE reconnection. Can you repro with a single direct request without urllib3 retry?

ryan_eng: I can take this — we shipped a change in 0.12.3 that altered how partial SSE data is buffered when a reconnect happens. If the client-side reconnects (urllib3) interleave with the SDK's reconnect logic it can leave the parser in a waiting state for the delimiter.

ryan_eng: Short-term workarounds:
- pin to 0.12.1 or 0.12.2
- set outer HTTP retry to 0 and let SDK handle reconnects
- enable a keepalive/heartbeat on your socket so the parser flushes (we have an env var REDWOOD_SSE_KEEPALIVE_MS you can set to 10000)

customer_terra: Ok I'll try pinning and disabling urllib3 retry now.

[~10m later]

customer_terra: Pinning to 0.12.1 fixed it — stream no longer stalls. Thanks.

ryan_eng: Thanks for confirming. We're cutting a patch (0.12.4) that restores robust partial-frame handling when reconnects overlap. I'll need a traceback + network debug logs from you to validate the fix before we publish. If you can set SDK_LOG_LEVEL=debug and send the sse trace that helps.

sre_bot: New issue created: SVC-1245 "python-sdk: sse parser deadlock on overlapping reconnects" assigned to eng-runtime, priority P2.

maria_support: Filing follow-up with customer for logs and ETA. Patch candidate targeted for tomorrow AM, will update once validated. :thumbsup:

ryan_eng: One more note — customers with upper-layer retries + token refresh race might also see spurious 401s; if you observe 401 during streaming please include auth logs. We're adding a guard in the reconnect logic to ignore in-flight auth-refresh reconnects.

jake_support: If anyone else hits this, point them to the temporary workaround: pip install redwood-sdk==0.12.1 and disable extra http-level retries. We'll post an announcement in #eng-releases once 0.12.4 is live.

maria_support: Closing loop here — customer confirmed workaround works, collecting debug logs for the patch. Will reopen thread if customer sees recurrence.
